Launch announcement
Atomic launches on 3 November.

AI-assisted application creation, visual editing and an open-source backend foundation for founders, freelancers and small businesses.
PARIS — 29 October 2026. Abstract Machines today announces Atomic, an AI app builder launching on Tuesday, 3 November 2026. Atomic helps people describe an application, shape it through conversation and visual editing, and publish a version they have reviewed.
A business may need a place for customers to book appointments, browse products or access a client workspace. Atomic brings the steps from that initial idea to a working web application into one interface. Users can begin with a prompt or a template, inspect the result and continue refining it.
The Canvas provides a view of an app’s screens and states, with controls for selected elements and whole-app styling. Comments can be attached to elements so feedback stays connected to the part of the app being discussed. Shared workspaces and app access controls support collaboration.
Atomic also exposes the generated source and its version history. Automated build and browser checks support review before publication; users remain responsible for checking that the app meets their intended workflows. The underlying Atom backend, developed by the same team, provides application identities, permissions and business data.
“We built Atomic for people who know what their business needs but don’t want to start with a blank code editor. Describe the app, shape it with AI, and make it something your customers can use.”Drasko Draskovic, Founder & CEO
Availability
Atomic launches Tuesday, 3 November 2026. Journalists can contact Drasko Draskovic for product walkthroughs, interviews and launch-access information.
Launch plans: Free ($0), Builder at $25/month, and Pro at $50/month.
About Abstract Machines
Abstract Machines is a Paris-based applied AI company building intelligent software and the infrastructure behind it. Its work combines application development, open-source engineering and research across connected systems, identity and confidential computing. Atomic is its AI app builder; Atom is the open-source backend providing identity, permissions and application data.
Drasko Draskovic · Founder & CEO
